name: Basic Bait
description: A simple bait bundle. Doesn't do much, but every angler starts somewhere.

name: Energy Drink
description: Keeps you alert and ready to cast again sooner. Reduces your fishing cooldown while equipped.

name: Lucky Charm
description: A small charm that seems to attract better luck out on the water. Improves your odds of a rare catch.

name: Golden Hook
description: A gleaming golden hook favored by legendary anglers. Significantly improves your luck.

name: Research Permit
description: An official permit. Doesn't do anything mechanically, but it looks great in your inventory.
